name: Theresa Sutton
source:
Theresa Sutton is [spoiler]Harry Foredale's wife[/spoiler] as of Book 3, Chapter 18. She is first seen in Book 1, Chapter 2.

Theresa is very talkative and bubbly. She is known to be a gossip, preferring to talk about superficial subjects. She is a bit insecure about this tendency to chatter, mentioning that her mother told her to be quiet during her debut, only for her to ruin it as she usually does by talking too much.

She is often ditzy and tends to behave inappropriately, such as talking loudly about Mr. Sinclaire's late wife at his dinner party. Occasionally she says or believes silly things, once convincing herself that Edgewater was haunted when she heard voices; this was later revealed to be Your Character and Annabelle Parsons speaking down the hall. 

[spoiler]In Book 3, Chapter 18, her name changes to Viscountess Theresa to reflect her marriage to Harry.[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Theresa_Sutton]Wiki[/url]]
